draft.text: You came in because your ankle is swollen, bruised, and painful.
You can stand on it but can't walk due to instability.
We found swelling on the outside of your ankle and tenderness on both the outside and inside.
X-rays showed a broken bone on the lateral side of your ankle.
You have a broken bone on the outside of your ankle, called a displaced lateral malleolus fracture at the Weber C level.
The doctor will talk to you about next steps, which may include surgery and physical therapy.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because you hurt your ankle while playing basketball.
You twisted it and now it is swollen, bruised, and painful.
We found swelling on the outside of your ankle.
There is tenderness on both the outside and inside of your ankle.
You have pain when we touch the outside of your ankle.
There is no obvious deformity, and your skin looks normal.
You may have a broken bone on the outside of your ankle.
This is called a displaced lateral malleolus fracture at the Weber C level.
This type of break can cause instability and pain.
The doctor will talk to you about next steps.
This may include surgery and physical therapy.
